_comment: Copy this file to keys.json (gitignored, never commit real keys). Every provider is optional: JARVIS runs fully local with none of them. A value can be a single string OR an array of strings - an array is a pool that JARVIS rotates through automatically when one key hits a free-tier rate limit.
gemini_voice: a key reserved for the voice interface, so heavy voice use doesn't consume the text-planning quota - falls back to 'gemini' if omitted
